response_contract.scientific_semantics: The Esri U.S. Federal Datasets public view references FEMA/ORNL/USGS USA Structures greater than 450 sq ft and is not the same entity as the original FEMA catalog FEMA-0209 publication or the unrelated historical narrow regional service. The hub advertises a September 13 2026 data currency; ArcGIS public view/item are mutable and do not independently establish a fixed release archive, exact country coverage or valid structure count. Local initial extent is not national coverage, and the national fullExtent may include world-wrap regions. Modelled structures are NOT parcel, insured value, policy, reconstruction cost, ownership, surveyed footprint or claims truth. Occupancy, population, address and local quality limitations require per-field and per-vintage review; no CAT source/model admission.
